data: What is the approximate value of the y-axis at the point where the blue line becomes flat?

The y-axis represents the frequency of the most frequent 100 words in the corpus. The blue line shows the frequency distribution of these words. At the point where the blue line becomes flat, the y-axis value is approximately 1. This can be inferred because the y-axis is on a logarithmic scale, and the flat portion of the line corresponds to a value of 1 on this scale.
